notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it has been a long time, but I have finished the update for the knight's Destiny and now it requires less space on the pc, You need less then 1 BG now.
A lot of bugs are fixed, some levels are redesigned.
The bugs in the puzzles and the mechanisms are fixed and some puzzles have been improved ! ! ! 
Thank you for your support and trust ! ! !
